detail: Manifest speaker values and transcript columns do not provide speaker identity; participant-only and interviewer-only controls were not run.
No prompt field is available; train-frequency repeated-turn removal and repeated-turn-only controls were run as a fixed-protocol proxy.
Front 25%, middle 50%, and back 25% transcript-position controls were run.
The manifest has no populated speaker or prompt text fields; interviewer/prompt-only controls were not run.
Per-question and question-block text controls were run using segment_id position.
